reasoning: Gui package import calls qt_make_features_available, which imports both private/public feature values into shared QT_FEATURE_<name> cache variables. The feature key is not module-qualified.
QtWayland src/CMakeLists.txt gates add_subdirectory(compositor) on QT_FEATURE_wayland_server before the child compositor/configure.cmake declaration can execute.
qt_evaluate_feature returns immediately for an already defined QT_FEATURE_<name>; defining the same name in another module is not proof of independent override.

Dirty-feature cleanup resets only QT_KNOWN_FEATURES once per configuration cycle. Imported qt_make_features_available does not register those features in that list; no supported local override of the imported OFF value is established by this audit.

Generated configuration files have module-specific file/include guards, but generated feature macro names remain QT_FEATURE_<name>. Compositor private global header includes QtGui private config before its own private config; separate filenames do not establish a safe conflicting macro definition.
No QtWayland configure/compiler probe was run. This source audit does not prove every possible adaptation impossible; it refuses an unproven independent-server-ON claim against unchanged GUI18.
server_feature_provider_audit.required_provider_obligation: A separately selected compatible QtGui provider exporting consistent server-ON cache/headers, or separately reviewed and demonstrated upstream-supported feature handling. This audit selects neither and never edits GUI18.
